reviewThread.head: Review thread on pull request #{number} ({branch}), {path}:{lines}:
reviewThread.headOutdated: Review thread on pull request #{number} ({branch}), {path}:{lines} (outdated, check the current code):

ask.one: If it asks for a change, make it, commit it and call mark_thread_fixed with the thread id and the commit: lich resolves the thread and replies on GitHub once that commit is pushed. If it asks a question or raises a point for the team, change nothing: bring it to me with your view. Never reply to or resolve the thread on GitHub yourself.
ask.other: Go through each thread. One that asks for a change: make it, commit it and call mark_thread_fixed with that thread's id and the commit, and lich resolves the thread and replies on GitHub once that commit is pushed. One that asks a question or raises a point for the team: change nothing for it, and bring it to me with your view. Never reply to or resolve a thread on GitHub yourself.
